global.name: Main Engine 500h Service
global.checklist:
1. Change lube oil and filters
2. Inspect injectors
3. Check cooling water pumps
4. Record running hours
global.precautions: Engine must be cold. Lock out fuel supply before starting.

global.name: Annual Hull Inspection
global.checklist:
1. Visual hull survey
2. Check anodes
3. Inspect through-hull fittings
4. Verify anti-fouling condition
global.precautions: Vessel in dry dock; confirm staging is secured.

global.name: Monthly Safety Round
global.checklist:
1. Test fire detection
2. Check liferaft hydrostatic release
3. Inspect EPIRB battery
4. Verify lifejacket count

global.name: Quarterly Navigation Check
global.checklist:
1. Update ECDIS charts
2. Calibrate gyro
3. Test radar performance
4. Verify AIS transmission
global.precautions: Do not disable AIS while underway.

project.name: Aurora Hull Survey
project.checklist:
1. Bow thruster tunnel inspection
2. Anode replacement
3. Propeller polish
